en.title: AI Act, Maltese version: Article 71(3) refers to Article 49(4) twice instead of Article 49(3) and (4)
en.summary: The other 23 versions refer to Article 49(3) and (4).
en.impact: The cross-reference in Maltese Article 71(3) omits Article 49(3), on deployers that are public authorities; the duty in Article 49(3) remains.
en.correction: Replace the first 49(4) with 49(3) in Maltese Article 71(3).

mt.title: L-Att dwar l-Intelliġenza Artifiċjali, verżjoni Maltija: l-Artikolu 71(3) jirreferi darbtejn għall-Artikolu 49(4) minflok għall-Artikolu 49(3) u (4)
mt.summary: It-23 verżjoni l-oħra jirreferu għall-Artikolu 49(3) u (4).
mt.impact: Ir-referenza fl-Artikolu 71(3) Malti tħalli barra l-Artikolu 49(3), dwar l-implimentaturi li huma awtoritajiet pubbliċi; l-obbligu fl-Artikolu 49(3) jibqa’.
mt.correction: L-ewwel 49(4) jinbidel b'49(3) fl-Artikolu 71(3) tal-verżjoni Maltija.
